headline: Ultra-runner Sophie Woods smashes the Alps crossing record
summary: The New Zealander ran the 2,000km Via Alpina in 29 days, beating both the men's and women's records by six days.
script: New Zealand ultra-runner Sophie Woods has set the fastest known crossing of the Alps, running two thousand kilometres in twenty-nine days. She beat the previous record by six days, crossing eight countries through storms and heat.
imageAlt: Ultra-runner Sophie Woods running through alpine terrain.
imageAltTwo: A mountain trail across the Alps at sunrise.
